title: Business Central Admin Center API - App Management

facts.text: Global app installation available from API version 2.6; PTE upload from version 2.29
API endpoints manage install, uninstall, update, and cancel operations for apps on environments
acceptIsvEula property must be set to true in request body to proceed with app installation
For PTEs, upload .app file via multipart form and specify deploymentSchedule as Immediate or UpdateWindow
PTE .app package cannot exceed 50MB size and must have .app file extension
Uninstalling PTE does not remove scheduled versions; use removeScheduledPteVersion endpoint separately
Dependencies can be automatically installed or updated to latest compatible version if requested
